page_title: UDI 0-4 ACM | Udinese v AC Milan 11/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+5' Arthur Atta (Udinese) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Marco Sportiello pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
90+4' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
87' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
87' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle. Jaka Bijol (Udinese) commits a foul after dangerous play.
85' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
83' Substitution. Lorenzo Lucca walks off the pitch and Damian Pizarro (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.
83' Here is a change. Rafael Leao is going off and Sergio Conceicao gives the last tactical orders to Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan).
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) coming on for Theo Hernandez.

81' 0 - 4 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan). Rafael Leao plays a fantastic through ball and finds Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the right side of the goal. It's now 0:4.
81' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
80' 10:12 – the total goal attempt statistics.
76' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Martin Payero (Udinese) replaces Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Simone Pafundi (Udinese) is replacing Thomas Kristensen.
74' 0 - 3 Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Maduka Okoye with a strike into the top left corner. He makes it 0:3.
74' The game has begun to heat up. Jaka Bijol (Udinese) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
73' A substitution has been made. Luka Jovic is replaced by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan).
73' Sergio Conceicao has decided to substitute Alejandro Jimenez and he is replaced by Riccardo Sottil (AC Milan).
69' Iker Bravo (Udinese) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
69' A great run from Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post.
67' Rui Modesto (Udinese) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
67' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
66' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
65' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Hassane Kamara is replaced by Rui Modesto (Udinese).
65' The substitution is prepared. Iker Bravo (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sandi Lovric.
64' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
61' Arthur Atta (Udinese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
60' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Sportiello, who smothers the ball.
59' Maduka Okoye displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
58' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
56' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is moving okay again after that injury scare.

55' Mike Maignan looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Sergio Conceicao has decided that Marco Sportiello (AC Milan) is the man to take his place.
52' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
52' The game is interrupted. Mike Maignan (AC Milan) suffers a horrific injury!
50' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
50' A lofted cross from Arthur Atta (Udinese) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
49' A nice individual effort by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
48' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' 0 - 2 Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:2.
45' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) will take the corner.
45' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.
44' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) produces a poor cross from the free kick which is easily turned away.
44' Rough tackle by Theo Hernandez (AC Milan). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' 0 - 1 Goal! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the left post. It's 0:1.
42' Half-chance! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Maduka Okoye reacts well to snuff out the attack.
39' The foul by Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) was seen by Juan Luca Sacchi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
35' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. AC Milan will take a corner kick.
34' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

33' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Mike Maignan is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
32' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the right post.
32' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
31' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
28' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
27' The ball is cleared after Hassane Kamara (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
26' Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
25' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
25' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
22' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Luca Sacchi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
21' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

18' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Good work from Udinese as they win a corner.
17' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
15' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
14' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes it short.
13' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. AC Milan have a corner.
13' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings in a cross from the corner, but Maduka Okoye reads it well and gathers the ball.
11' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
9' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Luca Sacchi saw the whole situation. AC Milan have a free kick from a promising distance.
9' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
6' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
4' A pass by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
2' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.

1' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Maduka Okoye. What a save! The linesman points to the corner flag, AC Milan are going to take it.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AC Milan will kick the game off.
